services.name: Cybersecurity

services.description: Custom software, web and mobile app development, UI/UX design, cloud migration, and API development — using tools like React, Next.js, Node.js, Flutter, and Laravel.

services.name: Digital Transformation Consulting
services.description: IT strategy, infrastructure assessment, process automation, and data/AI consulting for businesses.

services.name: Talent Development

softwareProjectPricing: For software and app projects, we quote the full project upfront, then break the cost into phases. Clients pay to start each phase, not the whole project at once — so you only pay for the next phase once you've approved the last one.

academy.model: Pay As You Learn. Every course is broken into steps you can buy one at a time, starting from as little as a few thousand naira — or you can take the full course at once for a better overall price. Every step you finish earns its own certificate, and finishing every step earns you the full course certificate too.

courses.name: Cybersecurity Foundations
courses.notes: 6 steps, pay-as-you-learn from ₦10,000 per step, or ₦100,000 for the full course.

courses.name: SOC Analyst 1
courses.notes: Covers SIEM tools, alert triage, incident response, and network monitoring.

courses.name: Ethical Hacking
courses.notes: Penetration testing specialization. We recommend completing Cybersecurity Foundations first.

courses.name: Data Analysis
courses.notes: Power BI, Excel, and SQL — 8 steps, 5 real-world portfolio projects.

courses.name: Full Stack Web Development
courses.notes: Starts from HTML, CSS, and JavaScript basics, goes all the way to React, Next.js, and the full MERN stack.

courses.name: Backend Specialization

academy.certificationJourney: Learn → Do (hands-on labs) → Score 70%+ on a capstone → Certify → Experience (internship placement) → Grow (alumni network).
